notes: Fixes: the black strip at the top of videos is gone — videos fill the screen edge to edge under the Following / For You tabs. Profile and Discover thumbnails now show each video's first frame instead of a gray tile. Sound is just on — videos play with audio by default, no mute button to hunt for. The like / comment / save buttons on videos sit noticeably higher. Captions and the audio name (with its disc icon) show at the bottom of every video, above the bottom bar. Share now opens your device's share sheet. Comments: swipe down on the sheet to close it, swipe up to expand it full-screen. Comment counts update the moment you add or delete a comment. Profile page cleaned up: a gear at the top left opens Settings, a pencil on your picture edits your profile, and Sign out now lives inside Settings.
